parts.text: Review this screen. The subtitle is #B0B0B0 on #FFFFFF. The button is white text on #FFC107, and it is 120 x 36 dp.
The subtitle fails AA at 2.17:1. The button text fails at 1.63:1. The 36 dp button is under the 48 dp minimum.
Is black text #212121 on white #FFFFFF readable, and is a 48 x 48 dp icon button big enough?
Yes. The contrast passes AA, and 48 x 48 dp meets the minimum.
